newsitem.title: INDIA: India's CARE downgrades VLS to CARE A +(FD).
newsitem.headline: India's CARE downgrades VLS to CARE A +(FD).

text.p: Credit Analysis & Research Ltd (CARE) said on Thursday it downgraded the rating for the fixed deposit programme of VLS Finance Ltd (VLS) for a limit of 15 million rupees from CARE AA(FD) Double A to CARE A+(FD) Single A plus.

The revised rating reflects the downtrend in VLS's operations, lower recovery performance, deterioration in asset quality, substantial depreciation in the portfolio of quoted investments and the general deterioration in the operating environment for NBFCs.
